title: The Rise of Digital Banking in Pakistan
excerpt: Digital banking, often referred to as online banking or Internet banking, is a banking system that enables customers to perform various financial activities and transactions using electronic devices and the Internet.
content:
Digital banking, often referred to as online banking or Internet banking, is a banking system that enables customers to perform various financial activities and transactions using electronic devices and the Internet. This modern approach to banking has revolutionized the way people manage their finances, offering convenience, accessibility, and efficiency like never before.

In Pakistan, the rise of digital banking has been nothing short of remarkable. With the widespread adoption of smartphones and increased internet penetration, more and more people are embracing digital banking solutions. This shift has not only made banking services more accessible to the masses but has also contributed to financial inclusion in the country.

Digital banking offers a wide range of services, from checking account balances and transferring funds to paying bills and applying for loans, all from the comfort of one's home or on the go. The convenience and time-saving benefits of digital banking have made it an integral part of modern life in Pakistan.

title: Askari Bank Signs with truID for Streamlined Remote Onboarding
excerpt: Askari Bank, a prominent bank in Pakistan, has taken a major stride toward enhancing its customer onboarding process by leveraging the services offered by truID.
content:
Askari Bank, a prominent bank in Pakistan, has taken a major stride toward enhancing its customer onboarding process by leveraging the services offered by truID. With a shared focus on efficiency, security, and customer experience, this collaboration is poised to reshape the way Askari Bank verifies the identities of its customers.

By integrating truID's advanced remote identity verification technology into its operations, Askari Bank is set to streamline and expedite the authentication process, ensuring a seamless and secure experience for its end-users. truID's innovative technology will enable Askari Bank to swiftly verify customer identities, reducing the need for manual intervention and paper-based processes. This partnership underlines Askari Bank's dedication to embracing cutting-edge solutions to enhance its services, while truID continues to solidify its position as a trusted partner in the identity verification landscape of Pakistan.

title: truID Showcases Innovative Solutions at SEECS, NUST Open House 2023
excerpt: truID's participation at SEECS, NUST Open House provided a platform to showcase its digital identity verification solutions, engage with faculty, industry representatives, and sponsor prizes, fostering innovation and collaboration.
content:
truID participated in the SEECS, NUST Open House 2023. The company set up an interactive display, showcasing its innovative digital solutions for identity verification and its diverse use cases. The event provided an excellent platform for truID to engage with the esteemed SEECS faculty members, industry representatives (NSTP, MoIT), and the bright students of National University of Sciences and Technology (NUST).

In an effort to encourage innovation in upcoming technologies, truID proudly sponsored the 2nd and 3rd prizes in the Electrical Engineering category. Representatives of truID, who served as judges, were deeply impressed by the caliber of talent, innovative ideas, and projects presented by the students.

truID extends its sincere congratulations to all the winners for their outstanding achievements. The company reaffirms its commitment to cultivating a culture of innovation and networking and looks forward to future opportunities for collaboration and growth.

title: truID Makes Impactful Presence at AITechverse, Showcasing Innovative Identity Verification Solutions
excerpt: truID excelled at AITechverse, engaging attendees, highlighting its verification system, attracting students, and receiving recognition from government officials.
content:
On February 21st to 23rd, 2023, truID participated in AITechverse, a grand event organized by the National Center for Artificial Intelligence (NCAI). AI Techverse showcased innovative startup ideas, fostered networking among startups and professionals, and provided a favorable platform for tech startups to exhibit their projects and engage with potential investors.

truID set up a stall where Director of Operations, Mahad Majeed, and Computer Vision Engineer, Subhan Tariq, from the R&D team effectively engaged with attendees and established valuable connections by informing them about the company's presence and innovative verification system. The team discussed truID's role in business verification with the attendees. truID's stall also attracted the attention of students who were keen to explore career and internship opportunities, as well as potential final-year projects.

The stall received a visit from the Interior Minister, Ahsan Iqbal, which highlighted the company's identification startup. The event provided an excellent platform for truID to interact with potential customers, investors, and industry professionals, allowing them to showcase their products and services and build valuable connections within the industry.

content: truID had the privilege of attending 'Future Fest,' a prominent tech conference held on January 6-8, 2023, in Lahore. title: truID won ISF Grant in 2023 from HEC/World Bank Group as one of the 15 most Innovative startups out of 226 across Pakistan
excerpt: truID secures the esteemed HEC Innovation Seed Fund grant, affirming its pioneering role in Pakistan's identity verification industry and enabling further expansion in the MENA region.
content:
truID, a leading provider of remote identity verification solutions, has been awarded the prestigious HEC Innovation Seed Fund (ISF) grant worth USD 35,000. The HEC ISF grant is renowned for recognizing and supporting the most innovative startups that have the potential to make significant contributions to the entrepreneurial landscape of Pakistan and beyond. In a highly competitive pool of 226 applicants, truID emerged as one of the top 15 recipients, solidifying its position as a pioneering force in the remote identity verification industry in Pakistan.

truID is on a mission to empower businesses with cutting-edge solutions that enable them to establish trust rapidly and effortlessly with their customers, while ensuring a seamless, secure, and efficient experience. Our unwavering commitment to continuous innovation, dedicated research and development has positioned us as industry leaders in the field of identity verification.

The HEC ISF grant is an integral part of the Higher Education Development in Pakistan (HEDP) project, an ambitious initiative by the Higher Education Commission (HEC) aimed at fostering entrepreneurship and driving economic growth in the country. As a distinguished recipient of this grant, truID will leverage the financial support to further expand its operations not only in Pakistan but also in the MENA region, solidifying its position as a regional leader in the remote identity verification sector.

title: truID Shines at SEE Pakistan's Event, Fostering Recognition and Forging Key Partnerships
excerpt: truID's participation at the SEE Pakistan event showcased its disruptive technology in remote identity verification, attracting attention from judges, investors, and government officials. The event led to correspondences with several key individuals leading to potential collaborations.
content:
truID was invited to participate in the event organized by SEE Pakistan on the 18th of August, 2022, at Expo Center, Lahore. The event showcased around 100 vibrant startups from all over the country, bringing forth a soft and progressive image of Pakistan.

 truID was represented by its CEO, Dr. Abid Rafique, and its core team member, Mr. Abdullah Cheema. With its disruptive technology in the remote identity verification landscape of Pakistan, truID remained the center of attention for judges, media personnel, investors, financial service providers, government officials, and the general public at large.

Mr. Asher Faisel Khan, CEO of Commtel and a seasoned financial services professional and senior jury member, appreciated the accuracy and speed with which truID verified the identity of individuals during our live demonstrations. He will be assisting truID in establishing a presence in the financial services industry, including commercial banks and microfinance fintechs.

truID also had fruitful discussions with Mr. SM Khurram, CEO of Programmers Force, the Platinum Sponsor of SEE Pakistan. He not only showed great interest in truID's technology but also expressed a desire to follow up for investment and strategic partnership.

truID was also approached by government officials with an intent to introduce truID to E-Khidmat centers in Pakistan, facilitating people with different services through instant verification. In addition, Mr. Khurram Zafar, an investment partner at 47 Ventures Ltd., visited our stall. He has always been a great admirer of truID's technology and has opened several doors for collaboration with his portfolio companies.
